title: Free tool reroutes Claude Code requests to alternative AI models with #AItools #OpenSource
description: A new GitHub repository offers a way to run Claude Code for free by rerouting its requests through a lightweight proxy to alternative AI models. Instead of sending requests directly to the native Anthropx models, this tool intercepts them and redirects to various other models such as DeepSeq, Kimi, Quen, OpenRouter, or even locally hosted models. The key insight is that Claude Code remains unaware of the switch, preserving the same interface and workflow while leveraging different underlying AI providers. This approach works because it maintains compatibility with the existing user environment and processes, making it seamless and flexible for users to choose or combine different AI backends based on their particular tasks. The setup requires minimal configuration through environment variables, lowering the barrier for adoption. Its viral appeal likely comes from enabling free use of Claude Code functionalities by substituting paid or restricted models with alternatives, providing significant value to developers and users seeking powerful AI tools without direct cost constraints. The business and consumer value lies in democratizing access to AI capabilities and flexibility in model choice, fostering innovation and customization in AI-powered projects without being locked to a single provider. #AI #OpenSource #ClaudeCode #GitHub #ProxyTool #ArtificialIntelligence #MachineLearning #FreeAI #DeepSeq #OpenRouter #Kimi #Quen #LocalAI #TechInnovation #AIModels #DeveloperTools
